BEFORE YOU BUILD THE DECK

One case. Three connected stages.

  1. Decide what you stand for.

    Frame the decision, compare three alternatives, and write the recommendation. Scores organise your judgment; evidence supports it.

  2. Shape the storyline.

    Generate an editable six-slide speaking outline from your own inputs. Adapt it to the official brief and required deliverables.

  3. Practice the defense.

    Rehearse the pitch against slide timings. Then prepare answers to six questions about your trade-offs, assumptions, economics, and execution.

Your cases and notes save only in this browser. Export a JSON backup to keep editing elsewhere. This MVP uses templates, not AI judging or research. Timer sessions reset on reload; saved notes and the last completed rehearsal remain. Follow your competition’s rules on tools and outside assistance.
